create.name: The Center for Mindful Living
create.bio:
The Center for Mindful Living is a Washington, DC meditation community rooted in the Buddhist insight tradition, with room too for secular mindfulness. Hugh Byrne, a long-time insight teacher and author, is its founding and guiding teacher, and Regina Flanigan, whom he mentored, now guides it with him. It opened in the city in 2012, belongs to the wider Insight Meditation Community of Washington network, and describes itself as a collective of teachers and practitioners who value spiritual friendship and an open door.

Since the pandemic most of its life has been online. A large rota of volunteer teachers leads short drop-in sits on Zoom from early morning to evening on most days of the week, with a longer Sunday class that includes a dharma talk, and the recordings are shared on YouTube. On Saturdays a Living Dharma Circle meets in person near Tenleytown, mixing sitting, a talk, gentle movement and shared reflection. There is a Spanish-language meditation group every other Wednesday, beginners' courses a few times a year, and a lively set of peer-led gatherings, from a poetry sangha to a book group. Teachings are offered freely, supported by donations.

free_resources.title: Meditation & Dharma Classes
free_resources.description: The weekly timetable of drop-in online sits, each led by one of the centre's volunteer teachers: short morning, noon and early-evening sessions on weekdays and a longer Sunday class with a talk. Times are US Eastern; beginners are welcome.

free_resources.title: In-Person Living Dharma Circle
free_resources.description: A Saturday morning gathering in north-west Washington with rotating teachers: sitting practice, a talk on the teachings, some gentle movement and time to reflect together. Open to newcomers and seasoned meditators; a donation is suggested but any amount is welcome.

free_resources.title: Grupo de Meditación
free_resources.description: A free Spanish-language meditation group on Zoom every other Wednesday evening, guided by trained instructors, with time to share experiences. No prior experience is needed; registration is required.
